concept.name: Bayesian optimization
concept.definition: Sequential hyperparameter optimization that uses a probabilistic surrogate of prior evaluations to choose promising next configurations.
concept.intuition: It estimates how a fitted choice behaves on observations that were not used to fit that choice.
concept.mechanics: Fit a surrogate to evaluated configurations and scores, maximize an acquisition function, run the proposed trial, and update the surrogate until the budget ends.
concept.failure_modes: Random splitting, overlapping labels, repeated tuning, or an unprotected final test set can produce optimistic estimates.
concept.misconceptions: Validation measures conditional generalization under a split design; it does not guarantee future market performance.
concept.example: After eight initial trials, expected improvement proposes a lower learning rate near the best observed region for trial nine.
